entities.name: Jan Janszoon van Nes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jan Janszoon van Nes was a Dutch admiral and brother of naval commander Aert Janszoon van Nes. They both took part in the Raid on the Medway of 1667. He was buried in the St. Lawrence Church in Rotterdam.
